title: Ultra Dense Vietnamese Noodles Mi Quang
description: A jammy and dense Vietnamese dish featuring chicken bouillon powder, perfect for a cozy meal. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and made with mi-quang noodles.
instructions: Cook the mi-quang noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large pot, combine the pork broth, chicken bouillon powder, and fish sauce, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the grilled pork, shrimp, and bean sprouts to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for 1 minute.
To assemble the dish, place some noodles in a bowl and add the hot broth and toppings.
Garnish with scallions and serve immediately.
Use a whisk to mix the broth and toppings together before serving.
Serve the dish hot and enjoy.
Repeat the process to make additional servings.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
